mfg1-electrical-l086.title: Pagbasa ng paper, line, text drafting instructions
mfg1-electrical-l086.objective: Ihiwalay ang paper size, line type/width, text, at dimension instructions.

paragraphs.title: Papel at border
paragraphs.text: A 0: 841×1189 mm, A 1: 594×841 mm, A 2: 420×594 mm, A 3: 297×420 mm, A 4: 210×297 mm. Textbook border examples: A 4～A 2 margin 10 mm, A 1 pataas 20 mm. Tingnan ang adopted form/binding margin sa drawing; huwag paper edge ang dimension reference.

paragraphs.title: Width at line type
paragraphs.text: Basic thin/thick ratio 1: 2; examples 0.18/0.35, 0.25/0.5, 0.35/0.7, 0.5/1.0 mm. Pantayin ang parehong function. Single-dot chain sa reference/pitch, double-dot sa imagined movement, wavy/zigzag break sa omitted boundary. Iba ang cutting location sa diagonal hatching ng cut surface.

paragraphs.title: Readable entries
paragraphs.text: Text heights: 2.5, 3.5, 5, 7, 10 mm. Iwasan ang crossing dimensions/duplicate sizes upang mabasa ang final dimension. Iba ang arc length, chord, central angle. Textbook M: milling, L: lathe sa process note; basahin kasama ang Ra. Tingnan ang version/legend.

terms.meaning: Linyang nagpapakita ng adjacent parts o motion range at iba pa.

mfg1-electrical-l086.activity:
Gabay na 30 minuto: 10 pag-unawa sa teksto, 8 pag-aayos ng halimbawa, 9 pagsulat, 3 pagbalik-tanaw.
Kalkulahin ang size ng kalahating A 2; ipaliwanag ang outline, imaginary, cut location, hatching. Bakit i-hold kung magkaiba ang duplicate dimensions?
safety: Tiyakin ang qualification, training, duty scope, at aprubadong procedure sa equipment operation, measurement, machining, o setting change.
mfg1-electrical-l086.summary: Sa paper, line, text instructions, tingnan ang structure, gamit, applicability, bukod sa pangalan.
